description: Give your AI agent a real US/Canada phone number: place and receive voice calls, send and receive SMS/iMessage, and hold threaded conversations — all over REST, metered per user against a $5 budget.

methods.name: agentphone.usage
methods.description: Account status: plan, phone-number hold limit (used/limit/remaining), and message/call/webhook stats. Call this first to orient in a session. Read-only; no charge.

methods.name: agentphone.usage_daily
methods.description: Daily usage breakdown for the last N days (max 365). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.usage_monthly
methods.description: Monthly usage aggregation. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.usage_by_number
methods.description: Usage broken down per phone number. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.usage_by_agent
methods.description: Usage broken down per agent over a period. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.list_voices
methods.description: List available text-to-speech voices (voice_id, voice_name, provider, gender, accent, preview_audio_url) across ElevenLabs, Cartesia, OpenAI, and platform voices. gender/accent/preview may be null — do not crash on missing fields. Use voice_id when creating/updating an agent. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.list_agents
methods.description: List your agents (phone personas: name, voiceMode, model tier, system prompt, attached numbers). You get one starter agent on account setup — ALWAYS list before creating another. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.create_agent
methods.description: Create an agent (phone persona). For AI-driven use pass voiceMode:"hosted" explicitly (the backend defaults to "webhook", which needs a configured webhook or inbound calls fail). systemPrompt is required for hosted. Pick a voice from agentphone.list_voices. Free (no telephony spend).

params.name: voiceMode
params.description: "hosted" (recommended — AgentPhone runs the LLM) | "webhook" (each turn POSTed to your endpoint). Defaults to webhook.

params.name: systemPrompt
params.description: Personality/instructions during hosted calls. Required if voiceMode=hosted.

params.name: beginMessage
params.description: What the agent says first when a call connects

params.name: voice
params.description: voice_id from agentphone.list_voices (default: Skylar — Friendly Guide)

params.name: transferNumber
params.description: E.164 number to transfer calls to on request

params.name: voicemailMessage
params.description: What to say if the callee goes to voicemail

params.name: interruptionSensitivity
params.description: 0.0–1.0, how easily callers can barge in (default 0.8)

params.name: enableMessaging
params.description: hosted agent may send/read texts mid-call (default true)

params.name: maxSilenceMs
params.description: hang up after this many ms of caller silence (default 600000)

params.name: language
params.description: BCP-47 locale, e.g. en-US, es-ES, ja-JP

methods.name: agentphone.get_agent
methods.description: Get one agent's full config and its attached numbers. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.update_agent
methods.description: Update an agent — only the fields you send change. Any create field is updatable (systemPrompt, voice, modelTier, …). Free.

params.name: systemPrompt
params.description: new instructions (any agent field may be updated)

methods.name: agentphone.delete_agent
methods.description: Delete an agent. Irreversible — clears the agent's references on its numbers/conversations/calls (those are NOT deleted). Confirm with your human first. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.attach_number
methods.description: Attach an existing number to an agent so the agent can call/text from it. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.detach_number
methods.description: Detach a number from an agent (the number is kept, just unassigned). Free.

methods.name: agentphone.list_agent_conversations
methods.description: List an agent's conversation threads, newest activity first (data[], hasMore, total). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.list_agent_calls
methods.description: List an agent's calls (data[], hasMore, total). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.list_numbers
methods.description: List your active phone numbers (id, phoneNumber, country, status, agentId). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.buy_number
methods.description: Provision a new US/CA phone number. COSTS $3.00 from your $5 Pilot budget (402 if it would overdraw). The provisioned number is saved to this host's ~/.pilot/.agentphone so you can recall it later with agentphone.mynumber — no need to store it yourself. Optionally attach to an agent and request an area code.

params.name: agentId
params.description: attach the new number to this agent immediately

methods.name: agentphone.get_number
methods.description: Get one phone number by id (any status, including released). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.release_number
methods.description: Release (delete) a number. IRREVERSIBLE — the number returns to the carrier pool; no refund for the unused month. Confirm with your human first. Free to call.

methods.name: agentphone.list_number_messages
methods.description: List messages on a number (inbound + outbound), newest first, cursor-paginated. THE non-websocket way to detect SMS replies: poll with the `after` cursor and filter direction=="inbound". Read-only.

params.name: before
params.description: ISO timestamp cursor — messages before this time

params.name: after
params.description: ISO timestamp cursor — messages after this time (advance it each poll)

methods.name: agentphone.list_number_calls
methods.description: List calls on a number. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.get_contact_card
methods.description: Get the iMessage contact card shown on a number (firstName, lastName, displayName, hasAvatar). iMessage only. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.set_contact_card
methods.description: Create/replace the iMessage contact card on a number (name + avatar shown to recipients). iMessage only. Free.

params.name: avatarUrl
params.description: public HTTPS URL of an avatar image

methods.name: agentphone.delete_contact_card
methods.description: Remove the iMessage contact card from a number. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.send_message
methods.description: Send an SMS/iMessage. COSTS MONEY (~$0.01–0.02, debited from your $5 budget → 402 if over). Auto-delivers over iMessage when both sides support it, else SMS/MMS — the response `channel` (sms|mms|imessage) tells you how it went. E.164 for `to_number` (or a group id grp_… for an iMessage group). iMessage-only extras (send_style, reply_to_message_id) are silently ignored on SMS.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: the sending agent (must have a number attached)

params.name: to_number
params.description: recipient in E.164 (+14155551234) or an iMessage group id (grp_…)

params.name: body
params.description: message text (may be empty if sending media only)

params.name: media_url
params.description: public HTTPS URL of one image/file to attach

params.name: media_urls
params.description: multiple media URLs (image carousel on iMessage)

params.name: number_id
params.description: specific number to send from (if the agent has several)

params.name: from_number
params.description: exact E.164 number to send from (alternative to number_id)

params.name: reply_to_message_id
params.description: iMessage only — thread inline under an earlier message id

methods.name: agentphone.react
methods.description: Send a tapback reaction to a message. iMessage ONLY — returns 400 on SMS. Free.

params.name: reaction
params.description: love | like | dislike | laugh | emphasize | question

methods.name: agentphone.list_calls
methods.description: List calls for the account (filter by status/direction). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.place_call
methods.description: Place an OUTBOUND voice call. COSTS MONEY (per-minute, ~$0.05+, debited from your $5 budget → 402 if over). With `systemPrompt` the AI runs the call autonomously (recommended); without it, each turn is POSTed to the agent's webhook. Returns a call id IMMEDIATELY (async) — the phone rings in a second or two. Then POLL agentphone.get_call every few seconds until status is completed/failed to read the transcript. Cannot call 911 / N11 / crisis lines (blocked).

params.name: agentId
params.description: the agent placing the call (must have a number attached)

params.name: systemPrompt
params.description: instructions for an autonomous call (recommended). Runs hosted regardless of the agent's voiceMode.

params.name: initialGreeting
params.description: the first line the AI says (auto-generated if omitted)

params.name: fromNumberId
params.description: specific number to call from (if the agent has several)

params.name: voice
params.description: override the agent's default voice for this call

params.name: variables
params.description: template variables injected into the prompt

methods.name: agentphone.get_call
methods.description: Get a call and its embedded transcripts[]. THE poll target for a call outcome (no websockets): call every few seconds until status is completed or failed (in-progress means partial/empty transcript). Also carries durationSeconds, startedAt, endedAt. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.end_call
methods.description: Terminate an in-progress call. status/endedAt settle shortly after via the provider — keep polling agentphone.get_call until terminal. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.get_transcript
methods.description: Get the full ordered transcript of a call as plain JSON (user utterance + agent response per turn). This is the REST/polling alternative to the SSE live-transcript stream — the adapter never uses the stream. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.list_conversations
methods.description: List conversation threads (one per external contact or iMessage group), sorted by lastMessageAt desc (data[], hasMore, total). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.get_conversation
methods.description: Get one conversation with its recent messages (participant, isGroup, group roster, messageCount, metadata). Read-only.

params.name: message_limit
params.description: how many recent messages to include

methods.name: agentphone.update_conversation
methods.description: Update a conversation's `metadata` (attach custom AI context/state to the thread). Free.

params.name: metadata
params.description: arbitrary JSON context to store on the thread

methods.name: agentphone.list_conversation_messages
methods.description: List a conversation's messages, cursor-paginated (data[], hasMore). Poll with `after` to catch new inbound replies in a thread. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.typing
methods.description: Show a typing indicator before you reply. iMessage only, best-effort, auto-expires (no stop call). Free.

methods.name: agentphone.set_background
methods.description: Set a chat background image for a conversation. iMessage only. Free.

params.name: image_url
params.description: public HTTPS URL of the background image

methods.name: agentphone.clear_background
methods.description: Clear a conversation's chat background. iMessage only. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.list_contacts
methods.description: List saved contacts (data[], hasMore, total); `search` filters by name/phone. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.create_contact
methods.description: Save a contact so you can look them up by name later. phoneNumber is normalized to E.164; returns 409 if the phone already exists. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.get_contact
methods.description: Get one contact by id. Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.update_contact
methods.description: Update a contact — only the fields you send change (phone is re-normalized; 409 on conflict). Free.

methods.name: agentphone.delete_contact
methods.description: Delete a contact. Confirm with your human first. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.get_webhook
methods.description: Get the account-level webhook config. Read-only. (Polling is the default event model for this adapter; webhooks are optional.)

methods.name: agentphone.set_webhook
methods.description: Set the account-level webhook URL (returns a signing `secret`; a new one each call). NOTE: on the shared Pilot AgentPhone account this is a GLOBAL setting — prefer per-agent webhooks or polling. Free.

params.name: url
params.description: your HTTPS endpoint that receives events

methods.name: agentphone.delete_webhook
methods.description: Remove the account-level webhook. Global on the shared account — use with care. Free.

methods.name: agentphone.list_webhook_deliveries
methods.description: List recent webhook delivery attempts (items[], total). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.webhook_delivery_stats
methods.description: Aggregated webhook delivery stats over the last N hours (success/failed/pending, byEventType, byHour). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.test_webhook
methods.description: Send a synthetic test event to verify your endpoint is reachable and verifying signatures. Free.

params.name: agentId
params.description: test the webhook for a specific agent

methods.name: agentphone.get_agent_webhook
methods.description: Get an agent-specific webhook (overrides the account default for that agent). Read-only.

methods.name: agentphone.set_agent_webhook
methods.description: Set an agent-specific webhook URL (overrides the account default for THIS agent only — safer than the account-level webhook on a shared account). Free.

methods.name: agentphone.delete_agent_webhook
methods.description: Delete an agent-specific webhook (the agent falls back to the account default). Free.

methods.name: agentphone.mynumber
methods.description: Recall the phone number(s) THIS daemon provisioned (local, no backend call, free). Reads ~/.pilot/.agentphone, populated automatically by agentphone.buy_number. Returns {entries:[{id,phoneNumber,status,agentId,...}]} — empty if this host hasn't provisioned one yet. Use it to find 'my number' without listing the shared account.

listing.tagline: A real phone number for your agent — voice calls, SMS/iMessage, and conversations over REST
listing.app_description:
# AgentPhone — a real phone number for your AI agent

AgentPhone gives your agent its **own real US/Canada phone number**: place and receive **voice calls**, send and receive **SMS & iMessage**, and hold threaded **conversations** with real people — all over plain REST. This is the managed Pilot front door: you bring **nothing** (no signup, no API key). Pilot holds one AgentPhone master key behind the broker and gives **each Pilot user a $5 budget**; calls and texts debit against it, and once it's spent the paid endpoints return `402 Payment Required` (reads stay free).

## What you can do

- **Call people.** `agentphone.place_call` with a `systemPrompt` runs an autonomous voice call — the phone rings in ~1–2s and the AI holds the conversation. Book a reservation, chase a shipment, return a missed call, or call another agent.
- **Text people.** `agentphone.send_message` delivers over **iMessage** when both sides support it (unlocking threaded replies, tapback reactions, send effects, typing indicators, group chats) and transparently falls back to **SMS/MMS** otherwise — same call either way.
- **Answer & follow up.** Poll `agentphone.list_number_messages` / `agentphone.list_conversation_messages` for inbound texts and `agentphone.get_call` for call transcripts — **no websockets required**.
- **Manage your setup.** Buy/release numbers, create and tune agents (voice, model tier, system prompt, ambience), keep an address book of contacts, and attach numbers to agents.

## How it works (no signup step)

Because this is the **managed** app, the AgentPhone account already exists behind the Pilot broker — you skip the `/v0/agent/sign-up` + `/v0/agent/verify` flow entirely. Just call the `/v1` methods below; the broker authenticates you as your Pilot identity, injects the master key, meters your spend, and forwards to `https://api.agentphone.ai`.

**Async, poll-based (no streaming):**
1. `agentphone.place_call` → returns a call `id` immediately; the call runs in the background.
2. Poll `agentphone.get_call` every few seconds until `status` is `completed` or `failed`, then read `transcripts[]` (or `agentphone.get_transcript`).
3. For inbound SMS, poll `agentphone.list_number_messages` with the `after` cursor and filter `direction == "inbound"`.

## Critical gotchas (read once)

- **You cannot call 911**, N11 numbers, or crisis lines — they're blocked. If your human has an emergency, tell them to dial directly.
- **Released numbers are gone forever** — no refund for the unused month. Confirm before `agentphone.release_number`.
- **Always use E.164**: `+14155551234` ✓ — never `(415) 555-1234` or `415-555-1234`. Assume `+1` for a bare US number and confirm if it matters.
- **Inbound calls need hosted mode OR a webhook.** Create agents with `voiceMode: "hosted"` explicitly (the backend defaults to `webhook`, which fails inbound if no webhook is set).
- **iMessage-only features** (reactions, send effects, typing, backgrounds, contact cards) are silently ignored on SMS — check the response `channel`.
- **Don't spam.** Unsolicited bulk calls/texts are illegal and get the account suspended.

## Cost & the $5 budget

Reads are free. Spending operations debit your per-user $5 Pilot budget: buying a number (**$3.00/mo**), placing a call (**per-minute**), and sending a text (**~$0.01–0.02**). When a call would overdraw, the broker returns `402` before anything is charged, and every response carries your remaining balance in the `X-Pilot-Credits-Remaining` header (micro-dollars).

Every method's parameters, kind, and latency class are discoverable at runtime via `agentphone.help`.
